correctness.rationale: For unselected cell (a,b), the selected-neighbor count equals d_H(a)+d_H(b). The zero/one degree criterion yields exhaustive both-covered, one-side-uncovered, both-uncovered cases. Corrected spanning star forests, contracted degree-two one-side forests, and nonspanning simple even cycles are proven necessary and sufficient under all proper-subset deletions. Cayley tree and alternating-cycle EGFs yield coefficients; standalone independent direct subset DP and exact-rational generating functions agree on thirteen boards (129155 nonempty subsets), with thin specialization tested n=5..20. No finite check substitutes for the proof.

value.rationale: Minimal forts define the irredundant fort-cover constraints for standard zero forcing. A two-parameter complete structural hypergraph and cardinality EGF for a classical graph product directly aid combinatorial and integer-program formulations, and the exact thin-board specialization yields unbounded gaps of n-5 missing sizes. This is not merely a known minimum or routine restatement of domination.
